text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —It's Mejiro Ardan! Mejiro Ardan overtakes Oguri Cap to brilliantly take the lead—!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I managed to win, but...
as expected, Oguri-san and the others are terrifyingly strong...!
Truly the center of this era...!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ――Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible run.
It seems I was still underestimating you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Miss, Oguri—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Good grief, can't let my guard down around you for a second.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I felt it through your running.
That sheer grit to tear everything down.
You sure showed me something amazing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Inari-san—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
You'll be entering it too, of course?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's what I intend to do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Then this time, I will be the one to win there.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's race, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes—
I wouldn't have it any other way, Oguri-san.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Just so you know, I'm running in the next Tenno Sho (Autumn) too. And Creek is, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (The Eternal Big Three, all gathered in one place...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha! What a great expression!
You're surprisingly easy to read, aren'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's a once-in-a-lifetime festival.
I'll be looking forward to it.
See ya, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It seems heaven's fortune is on our side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The Eternal Big Three, all gathered together.
This is a situation beyond what we could have ever hoped for.
choice_data_list: Let's build on today's results going forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will stake everything I have achieved up to now on the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And... we will definitely win!

"Upon whom will history—the 'now'—smile?
The moment that would reveal the answer
was fast approaching—"
